# Authenticated API access via environment

GitHubGateway requires a token supplied via the KC_GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable or GITHUB_TOKEN; if no token is present it raises ForgeError. The API base URL is taken from KC_GITHUB_API or defaults to https://api.github.com.

Force authenticated, configurable access to the GitHub API and allow overriding the API base (e.g. for GitHub Enterprise).
